q: What do Rabale's chemical and bulk drug units use in energy, and what do listed pharma buyers ask?
title: Rabale bulk drug units: energy and buyer asks
short: Rabale's 70 or so chemical and bulk drug units, inside TTC-MIDC, use 20,501 toe a year on electricity and furnace oil for about 421,000 t of output. A listed pharma buyer may ask for your Scope 1 and 2 if you supply 2% or more of its purchases.
audience: Chemical and bulk drug suppliers in Rabale and TTC-MIDC, Navi Mumbai

ul: About 70 chemical and bulk drug units inside TTC-MIDC, which has over 4,000 units in all.
Products: tablets, ointments, oral drugs, process oils, paints and solvents, for India and export.
20,501 toe a year, which works out to about 0.049 toe, or 2.0 GJ, per tonne of output.
Main energy: grid electricity and furnace oil.

sections.h: Why the split decides your CO2
p: The cluster summary gives no split between power and oil, and it changes the answer by more than double. If all 20,501 toe were electricity, it would be about 160,900 t CO2; if all furnace oil, about 66,400 t. Your own figure needs kWh and litres, not a total energy bill.

sections.h: What a listed buyer can ask
ul: SEBI's BRSR value chain rules cover partners that each make up 2% or more of a top 250 listed company's purchases or sales.
The disclosure is voluntary from FY 2025-26, with assessment or assurance voluntary from FY 2026-27, so requests vary by buyer.
Typical asks: Scope 1 and 2 for the year, energy used, and the basis of each figure.

ol: Electricity: kWh from twelve months of bills, times 0.675 kg CO2.
Furnace oil: litres from invoices, times 2.97 kg CO2; boiler diesel at 2.645 kg.
Total, with the factors named, and tonnes produced, so the buyer can pro-rate to what it bought.

example.title: A unit making 6,000 t a year at the cluster average (estimate)
lines: Energy: 6,000 t x 0.049 toe = about 292 toe
If half is power: 146 toe = about 1,700 MWh x 0.675 = 1,150 t CO2
Other half as furnace oil: 146 toe x 41.868 GJ x 77.4 kg = 473 t CO2
Total about 1,620 t CO2, or 0.27 t per tonne
example.note: The 50:50 split is an assumption for the arithmetic; the cluster summary does not give one. Use your own bills.

senseible: Senseible turns your bills and oil invoices into BRSR-ready Scope 1 and 2 figures with the factor shown on each line, so the file you send a listed buyer can be traced back.
